  x   <- unique(as.character(x))
  sfx <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^[A-Za-z_]+", "", x)))
  if (all(!is.na(sfx))) x[order(sfx)] else sort(x)
}

# Introduction

Tissues are organised into local microenvironments, or *niches*, in which particular cell types and
molecular programmes co-occur. Identifying niches matters because their composition and spatial
arrangement are often more informative about tissue function and disease state than bulk or
per-cell expression alone.

**STniche** (part of *spatialGE*) detects niches directly from spatial transcriptomics data in three steps:

1. **Gene-set scoring.** Each spot or cell receives an activity score for every gene set of interest.
2. **Spatial autocorrelation.** A local Moran's I statistic (reported as a Z-score, *Zi*) measures
   whether each gene set is spatially concentrated around that location, rather than merely expressed.
3. **Clustering.** The Zi profiles are clustered (model-based clustering, number of niches chosen by BIC),
   so that each niche is defined by *which programmes are locally organised together*.

This vignette applies STniche to two technologies and uses each to answer a specific question:

| Dataset | Technology | Question |
|:--|:--|:--|
| GSE175540 (24 RCC sections, FFPE and fresh frozen) | Visium (spot level) | Do STniche niches recover pathologist-annotated tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS)? |
| ccRCC tumour fields of view (FOVs) | CosMx (single-cell level) | Which cell types and immune programmes define each niche, and does niche-level immune activity differ between immunotherapy (IO)-naive and IO-exposed tumours? |

# Setup and data

All data are downloaded automatically on first use (GEO for Visium; Zenodo and Springer for CosMx).
Set `visium_root`, `cosmx_root` or `out_root` in the YAML header to reuse local copies.
Only the analysis steps are echoed in this document; download and import code is hidden for readability.

```{r settings, results="hide"}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) {
  if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0L || identical(a, "")) b else a
}

ensure_download <- function(url, dest, min_bytes = 1e6, retries = 2L,
                            referer = NULL, user_agent = NULL) {
  dir.create(dirname(dest), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(dest) && file.size(dest) >= min_bytes) {
    cat("  [SKIP] ", basename(dest), " (",
        round(file.size(dest) / 1024^2, 1), " MB)\n", sep = "")
    return(invisible(TRUE))
  }
  if (file.exists(dest)) file.remove(dest)
  ua <- user_agent %||% "R-spatialGE"
  for (i in seq_len(retries)) {
    cat("  [DOWNLOAD try ", i, "] ", basename(dest), " ...\n", sep = "")
    ok <- FALSE
    if (nzchar(Sys.which("curl"))) {
      extra <- paste0(
        "-L -sS -C - ",
        if (!is.null(referer)) sprintf("-e '%s' ", referer) else "",
        sprintf("-A '%s' ", ua))
      ok <- tryCatch({
        system(sprintf("curl %s -o %s '%s'",
                       extra, shQuote(dest), url)) == 0L
      }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    }
    if (!ok) {
      ok <- tryCatch({
        utils::download.file(url, dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
        TRUE
      }, error = function(e) FALSE, warning = function(w) FALSE)
    }
    if (ok && file.exists(dest) && file.size(dest) >= min_bytes) {
      return(invisible(TRUE))
    }
  }
  stop("Failed to download: ", url, " -> ", dest)
}

GEO_VISIUM_URL <- paste0(
  "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE175nnn/",
  "GSE175540/suppl/GSE175540_RAW.tar"
)
ZENODO_COSMX_URL <- paste0(
  "https://zenodo.org/records/12730227/files/seurat_object.Rds?download=1"
)
SPRINGER_CLINICAL_URL <- paste0(
  "https://static-content.springer.com/esm/",
  "art%3A10.1186%2Fs13059-024-03435-z/MediaObjects/",
  "13059_2024_3435_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx"
)
SPRINGER_REFERER <- paste0(
  "https://genomebiology.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s13059-024-03435-z"
)

data_root <- file.path(tempdir(), "spatial_data")
dir.create(data_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

visium_root <- if (nzchar(params$visium_root %||% "")) {
  path.expand(params$visium_root)
} else file.path(data_root, "Visium", "GSE175540")

cosmx_root <- if (nzchar(params$cosmx_root %||% "")) {
  path.expand(params$cosmx_root)
} else file.path(data_root, "CosMx", "CosMx_ccRCC")

out_root <- if (nzchar(params$out_root %||% "")) {
  path.expand(params$out_root)
} else file.path(tempdir(), "spatialGE_outputs")
dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

run_visium <- isTRUE(params$run_visium)
run_cosmx  <- isTRUE(params$run_cosmx)
stopifnot(run_visium || run_cosmx)

n_cores  <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

visium_cfg <- NULL
if (run_visium) {
  gse_root <- visium_root

  visium_ready <- dir.exists(gse_root) &&
    any(grepl("^ffpe|^frozen",
              basename(list.dirs(gse_root, recursive = FALSE))))

  if (!visium_ready) {
    cat("\n=== Visium: auto-download from GEO ===\n")
    dir.create(gse_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    tarball <- file.path(gse_root, "GSE175540_RAW.tar")
    ensure_download(GEO_VISIUM_URL, tarball, min_bytes = 900e6)

    cat("  [EXTRACT] tar -xf ...\n")
    system(sprintf("tar -xf %s -C %s",
                   shQuote(tarball), shQuote(gse_root)))

    cat("  [FIX] Decompress spatial .gz ...\n")
    for (f_gz in list.files(gse_root,
                            pattern = "\\.(csv|json|png)\\.gz$",
                            full.names = TRUE)) {
      system(sprintf("gunzip -kf %s", shQuote(f_gz)))
    }

    cat("  [FIX] Restructure into per-sample folders ...\n")
    h5s <- list.files(gse_root, pattern = "_feature_bc_matrix\\.h5$",
                      full.names = TRUE)
    for (h5 in h5s) {
      base_name <- sub("_(filtered|raw)_feature_bc_matrix\\.h5$", "",
                       basename(h5))
      sample    <- sub("^GSM\\d+_", "", base_name)
      sdir      <- file.path(gse_root, sample)
      spdir     <- file.path(sdir, "spatial")
      dir.create(spdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      new_h5 <- file.path(sdir, basename(h5))
      if (!file.exists(new_h5)) file.rename(h5, new_h5)
      for (std in c("tissue_positions_list.csv", "scalefactors_json.json",
                    "tissue_hires_image.png", "tissue_lowres_image.png",
                    "TLS_annotation.csv")) {
        src <- file.path(gse_root, paste0(base_name, "_", std))
        dst <- file.path(spdir, std)
        if (file.exists(src) && !file.exists(dst)) file.rename(src, dst)
      }
    }

    cat("  [FIX] Prefix collisions ...\n")
    sd <- list.dirs(gse_root, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
    sn <- basename(sd)
    colliders <- sn[vapply(sn, function(n)
      any(sn != n & startsWith(sn, n)), logical(1))]
    for (n in colliders) {
      old    <- file.path(gse_root, n)
      padded <- paste0(sub("_[^_]+$", "_", n),
                       sprintf("%02d", as.integer(sub("^.*_", "", n))))
      new    <- file.path(gse_root, padded)
      if (!dir.exists(new)) file.rename(old, new)
    }
    visium_ready <- TRUE
    cat("  [DONE] Visium ready at ", gse_root, "\n", sep = "")
  }

  if (!visium_ready)
    stop("Visium root not ready after download: ", gse_root)

  ds_root     <- gse_root
  visium_mode <- "GSE175540"

  out_dir_v <- file.path(out_root, "spatialGE_out", "GSE175540")
  dir.create(out_dir_v, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  cat("Platform  : visium (", visium_mode, ")\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Input   : ", ds_root,    "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Out dir : ", out_dir_v, "\n", sep = "")
  visium_cfg <- list(ds_root = ds_root, out_dir = out_dir_v,
                     mode = visium_mode)
} else {
  cat("Platform  : visium (disabled)\n")
}

cosmx_cfg <- NULL
if (run_cosmx) {
  cosmx_fov <- params$cosmx_fov
  step123   <- file.path(out_root, "cosmx_step1_2_3")
  out_dir_c <- file.path(out_root, "spatialGE_out", "cosmx")
  dir.create(step123, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(out_dir_c, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(cosmx_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  seu_path  <- file.path(cosmx_root, "seurat_object.Rds")
  clin_path <- file.path(cosmx_root, "13059_2024_3435_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx")

  if (!file.exists(seu_path) || file.size(seu_path) < 500e6) {
    cat("\n=== CosMx: auto-download seurat_object.Rds from Zenodo ===\n")
    ensure_download(ZENODO_COSMX_URL, seu_path, min_bytes = 500e6)
  }
  if (!file.exists(clin_path) || file.size(clin_path) < 1000) {
    cat("\n=== CosMx: auto-download clinical xlsx from Springer ===\n")
    ensure_download(SPRINGER_CLINICAL_URL, clin_path, min_bytes = 1000,
                    referer = SPRINGER_REFERER, user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0")
  }

  inputs <- c(
    clinical_xlsx = clin_path,
    seurat_rds    = seu_path
  )
  miss <- names(inputs)[!file.exists(inputs)]
  if (length(miss)) {
    stop("Missing CosMx inputs in ", cosmx_root, ":\n  ",
         paste(miss, collapse = "\n  "),
         "\nCheck network access, or set cosmx_root to a folder containing these files.")
  }
  cat("Platform  : cosmx (enabled)\n")
  cat("  Input   : ", cosmx_root, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Out dir : ", out_dir_c,  "\n", sep = "")
  cosmx_cfg <- list(cosmx_root = cosmx_root, cosmx_fov = cosmx_fov,
                    step123 = step123, out_dir = out_dir_c,
                    inputs = inputs)
} else {
  cat("Platform  : cosmx (disabled)\n")
}
```

```{r build-data, results="hide"}
STs <- list()

# ---------------- Visium ----------------
if (run_visium) {
  cat("\n==========================================================\n")
  cat("Building Visium STlist (", visium_cfg$mode, ")\n", sep = "")
  cat("==========================================================\n")

  sample_dirs <- list.dirs(visium_cfg$ds_root, recursive = FALSE,
                           full.names = TRUE)
  sample_dirs <- sample_dirs[sapply(sample_dirs, function(d) {
    length(list.files(d, pattern = "_filtered_feature_bc_matrix\\.h5$")) > 0
  })]
  if (length(sample_dirs) == 0)
    stop("No Space-Ranger sample folders under ", visium_cfg$ds_root)

  n_symlinks_removed <- 0L
  for (d in sample_dirs) {
    for (rel in c("filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
                  file.path("spatial", "tissue_positions_list.csv"),
                  file.path("spatial", "scalefactors_json.json"),
                  file.path("spatial", "tissue_hires_image.png"))) {
      fp <- file.path(d, rel)
      if (nzchar(Sys.readlink(fp))) {
        unlink(fp, force = TRUE)
        n_symlinks_removed <- n_symlinks_removed + 1L
      }
    }
  }
  if (n_symlinks_removed > 0)
    cat("Removed ", n_symlinks_removed,
        " stale canonical symlink(s) before loading.\n", sep = "")

  sample_names <- basename(sample_dirs)
  collide <- vapply(sample_names, function(n) {
    any(sample_names != n & startsWith(sample_names, n))
  }, logical(1))
  if (any(collide)) {
    stop("Prefix-colliding Visium sample names: ",
         paste(sample_names[collide], collapse = ", "),
         ". Rename these directories on disk to pad the trailing number ",
         "(e.g. ffpe_c_2 -> ffpe_c_02) before re-running.")
  }

  cat("Samples: ", length(sample_dirs),
      " → ", paste(head(sample_names, 6), collapse = ", "),
      if (length(sample_names) > 6) ", …\n" else "\n", sep = "")

  per_sample <- lapply(sample_dirs, function(d) {
    nm <- basename(d)
    cat("  building ", nm, " … ", sep = "")
    st_i <- tryCatch(STlist(d, samples = nm, cores = 1),
                     error = function(e) { cat("FAILED (", e$message, ")\n"); NULL })
    if (is.null(st_i)) return(NULL)
    st_i <- tryCatch(filter_data(st_i, spot_minreads = 500,
                                 spot_mingenes = 300),
                     error = function(e) st_i)
    st_i <- tryCatch(transform_data(st_i, method = "log", cores = 1),
                     error = function(e) st_i)
    cat("ok (", nrow(st_i@spatial_meta[[nm]]), " spots)\n", sep = "")
    st_i
  })
  names(per_sample) <- sample_names
  per_sample <- per_sample[!vapply(per_sample, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(per_sample) == 0)
    stop("None of the Visium samples could be loaded.")

  st_v <- methods::new("STlist")
  st_v@counts       <- list()
  st_v@tr_counts    <- list()
  st_v@spatial_meta <- list()
  st_v@sample_meta  <- tibble(sample = character(0))
  for (nm in names(per_sample)) {
    s <- per_sample[[nm]]
    st_v@counts[[nm]]       <- s@counts[[nm]]
    st_v@tr_counts[[nm]]    <- s@tr_counts[[nm]]
    st_v@spatial_meta[[nm]] <- s@spatial_meta[[nm]]
    st_v@sample_meta        <- rbind(st_v@sample_meta, s@sample_meta)
  }

  STs$visium <- list(st       = st_v,
                     smp1     = names(st_v@spatial_meta)[1],
                     out_dir  = visium_cfg$out_dir,
                     label    = paste0("Visium (", length(names(st_v@spatial_meta)),
                                       " samples, ", visium_cfg$mode, ")"),
                     fov      = NA_character_,
                     mode     = visium_cfg$mode)
  cat("Visium STlist: ", length(st_v@spatial_meta),
      " samples merged\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("Visium: skipped.\n")
}

# ---------------- CosMx ----------------
if (run_cosmx) {
  cat("\n==========================================================\n")
  cat("Building CosMx STlist (multi-FOV)\n")
  cat("==========================================================\n")
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Seurat); library(tibble); library(stringr)
  })

  io_annot <- read_excel(cosmx_cfg$inputs["clinical_xlsx"],
                         sheet = "Table S11", skip = 1) %>%
    select(1:7) %>%
    mutate(IO = if_else(
      is.na(`Immunotherapy before Sample Collection`) |
        `Immunotherapy before Sample Collection` == "None",
      "IO-naive", "IO-exposed"))
  write_csv(io_annot, file.path(cosmx_cfg$step123, "Table_S11_IO_annotated.csv"))

  seu <- readRDS(cosmx_cfg$inputs["seurat_rds"])
  seu$annotation    <- trimws(seu$annotation)
  seu@meta.data$fov <- as.integer(as.character(seu@meta.data$fov))

  fov_annotation <- seu@meta.data %>%
    count(Slide_name, fov, annotation, name = "n_cells") %>%
    group_by(Slide_name, fov) %>%
    slice_max(n_cells, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rename(FOV_majority = annotation)

  io_map <- io_annot %>%
    transmute(Slide_name = trimws(`Tissue Slide`),
              fov = as.integer(as.character(FOV)),
              IO  = trimws(IO)) %>%
    distinct(Slide_name, fov, .keep_all = TRUE)

  design <- fov_annotation %>%
    left_join(io_map, by = c("Slide_name", "fov")) %>%
    arrange(Slide_name, fov)
  write_csv(design, file.path(cosmx_cfg$step123,
                              "FOV_design_with_IO_status.csv"))

  seu@meta.data <- seu@meta.data %>%
    left_join(fov_annotation[, c("Slide_name", "fov", "FOV_majority")],
              by = c("Slide_name", "fov")) %>%
    left_join(io_map, by = c("Slide_name", "fov"))

  requested <- if (!is.null(params$cosmx_fovs)) {
    as.character(params$cosmx_fovs)
  } else {
    raw <- as.character(params$cosmx_fov)
    if (identical(tolower(raw), "all")) {
      design %>%
        dplyr::filter(FOV_majority == "Tumor", !is.na(IO)) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(fov_name = paste0(Slide_name, "_fov", fov)) %>%
        dplyr::pull(fov_name)
    } else {
      trimws(strsplit(raw, ",")[[1]])
    }
  }
  requested <- unique(requested[!is.na(requested) & nzchar(requested)])
  if (length(requested) == 0)
    stop("No CosMx FOVs requested; check params$cosmx_fov / params$cosmx_fovs.")

  design_key <- paste0(design$Slide_name, "_fov", design$fov)
  unknown    <- setdiff(requested, design_key)
  if (length(unknown) > 0) {
    warning("Requested FOVs not present in design (skipped): ",
            paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))
    requested <- intersect(requested, design_key)
  }
  if (length(requested) == 0)
    stop("None of the requested FOVs exist in the FOV design sheet.")
  cat("Requested FOVs: ", paste(requested, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")

  pick_count_assay <- function(obj) {
    for (a in Assays(obj)) {
      ok <- tryCatch({GetAssayData(obj, assay = a, layer = "counts"); TRUE},
                     error = function(e) tryCatch({
                       GetAssayData(obj, assay = a, slot = "counts"); TRUE},
                       error = function(e) FALSE))
      if (ok) return(a)
    }
    stop("No assay with a counts matrix in Seurat object.")
  }
  assay_use <- pick_count_assay(seu)
  cat("Using counts assay: ", assay_use, "\n", sep = "")

  counts_all <- tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay_use, layer = "counts"),
    error = function(e) GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay_use, slot = "counts"))
  if (ncol(counts_all) == ncol(seu) &&
      !identical(colnames(counts_all), colnames(seu)))
    colnames(counts_all) <- colnames(seu)

  imgs <- Images(seu)
  coords_all <- NULL
  if (length(imgs) > 0) {
    for (im in imgs) {
      ctr <- seu@images[[im]][["centroids"]]
      if (is.null(ctr)) next
      tc <- as.data.frame(Seurat::GetTissueCoordinates(ctr))
      if (!all(c("x","y","cell") %in% colnames(tc))) next
      add <- data.frame(id   = tc$cell,
                        xpos = as.numeric(tc$x),
                        ypos = as.numeric(tc$y),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      coords_all <- if (is.null(coords_all)) add
                    else rbind(coords_all,
                               add[!add$id %in% coords_all$id, , drop = FALSE])
    }
  }
  if (is.null(coords_all)) {
    md2 <- seu@meta.data
    cx <- intersect(c("x","xpos","pxl_col_in_fullres","CenterX"),
                    colnames(md2))[1]
    cy <- intersect(c("y","ypos","pxl_row_in_fullres","CenterY"),
                    colnames(md2))[1]
    if (is.na(cx) || is.na(cy))
      stop("No coordinates in images or meta.data; cannot build CosMx STlist.")
    coords_all <- data.frame(id   = rownames(md2),
                             xpos = as.numeric(md2[[cx]]),
                             ypos = as.numeric(md2[[cy]]),
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  ct_col <- intersect(
    c("nb_clus", "lasso_final", "annotation", "celltype", "cell_type"),
    colnames(seu@meta.data))[1]
  if (is.na(ct_col))
    stop("seu@meta.data has no usable cell-type column ",
         "(tried: nb_clus / lasso_final / annotation / celltype / cell_type).")

  id_col <- intersect(
    c("id", "cell_ID", "cell_id", "cell", "barcode", "Barcode", "CellID"),
    colnames(seu@meta.data))[1]
  if (is.na(id_col)) {
    cell_ids <- rownames(seu@meta.data)
    message("No explicit cell-ID column; using rownames(seu@meta.data).")
  } else {
    cell_ids <- as.character(seu@meta.data[[id_col]])
  }

  celltypes <- seu@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      unique_fov  = paste0(Slide_name, "_", fov),
      id          = trimws(cell_ids),
      lasso_final = as.character(.data[[ct_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(unique_fov, id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  cat("Cell types from seu@meta.data$", ct_col,
      " (cell ID from column '", id_col, "') — ",
      nrow(celltypes), " cells\n", sep = "")
  cat("Top cell types:\n")
  print(head(sort(table(celltypes$lasso_final), decreasing = TRUE), 8))

  build_one_fov <- function(fov_name) {
    parts <- stringr::str_match(fov_name, "^(RCC\\d+)_fov(\\d+)$")
    if (is.na(parts[1, 1])) {
      warning("Skipping malformed FOV name: ", fov_name); return(NULL)
    }
    slide_name <- parts[1, 2]
    fov_int    <- as.integer(parts[1, 3])

    row_idx <- which(design$Slide_name == slide_name & design$fov == fov_int)
    if (length(row_idx) == 0) {
      warning("No design row for ", fov_name, "; skipped."); return(NULL)
    }
    tissue_lab <- design$FOV_majority[row_idx[1]]
    io_label   <- design$IO[row_idx[1]]
    if (is.na(io_label)) {
      warning("No IO label for ", fov_name, "; skipped."); return(NULL)
    }

    cells_keep <- rownames(seu@meta.data)[
      seu@meta.data$Slide_name    == slide_name &
        seu@meta.data$fov         == fov_int    &
        seu@meta.data$FOV_majority == tissue_lab &
        seu@meta.data$IO          == io_label
    ]
    cells_keep <- intersect(cells_keep, colnames(seu))
    if (length(cells_keep) < 10) {
      warning(fov_name, ": fewer than 10 cells matched; skipped."); return(NULL)
    }

    counts_sub <- counts_all[, cells_keep, drop = FALSE]

    if (all(cells_keep %in% coords_all$id)) {
      target_ids <- cells_keep
    } else {
      overlap <- sapply(colnames(seu@meta.data), function(col) {
        v <- seu@meta.data[[col]]
        if (is.factor(v)) v <- as.character(v)
        if (!is.character(v)) return(NA_real_)
        mean(trimws(v) %in% coords_all$id, na.rm = TRUE)
      })
      overlap  <- sort(overlap[!is.na(overlap)], decreasing = TRUE)
      best_col <- names(overlap)[1]
      id_map        <- trimws(as.character(seu@meta.data[[best_col]]))
      names(id_map) <- rownames(seu@meta.data)
      target_ids    <- id_map[cells_keep]
      n_mapped <- mean(target_ids %in% coords_all$id)
      if (!is.finite(n_mapped) || n_mapped < 0.95) {
        warning(fov_name, ": mapping via '", best_col, "' covers only ",
                round(100 * n_mapped, 1), "% — skipped.")
        return(NULL)
      }
    }
    idx <- match(target_ids, coords_all$id)
    if (any(is.na(idx))) {
      warning(fov_name, ": ", sum(is.na(idx)),
              " cells unmapped to coords; skipped."); return(NULL)
    }
    coords_sub <- data.frame(libname = cells_keep,
                             xpos    = coords_all$xpos[idx],
                             ypos    = coords_all$ypos[idx],
                             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    stopifnot(identical(coords_sub$libname, colnames(counts_sub)))

    ct_key <- paste0(slide_name, "_", fov_int)
    ct <- celltypes[celltypes$unique_fov == ct_key, c("id", "lasso_final")]
    if (nrow(ct) == 0) {
      warning(fov_name, ": no celltypes rows for unique_fov=", ct_key); return(NULL)
    }
    id_for_key <- trimws(as.character(seu@meta.data[cells_keep, id_col]))
    ct_df <- data.frame(id        = trimws(ct$id),
                        cell_type = ct$lasso_final,
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cell_type_vec <- ct_df$cell_type[match(id_for_key, ct_df$id)]

    n_typed <- sum(!is.na(cell_type_vec))
    cat(sprintf("  %-12s | tissue=%-6s | IO=%-10s | %d cells | %d typed (%.0f%%)\n",
                fov_name, tissue_lab, io_label,
                length(cells_keep), n_typed,
                100 * n_typed / length(cells_keep)))

    sample_name <- fov_name
    st <- methods::new("STlist")
    st@counts       <- setNames(list(counts_sub), sample_name)
    sm <- coords_sub
    sm$id_key    <- id_for_key
    sm$cell_type <- cell_type_vec
    st@spatial_meta <- setNames(list(sm), sample_name)
    st@sample_meta  <- tibble(sample = sample_name)
    st <- transform_data(st, method = "sct")
    st
  }

  st_per_fov <- lapply(requested, build_one_fov)
  names(st_per_fov) <- requested
  st_per_fov <- st_per_fov[!vapply(st_per_fov, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(st_per_fov) == 0)
    stop("No CosMx FOVs could be built. See warnings above.")

  st_multi <- methods::new("STlist")
  st_multi@counts       <- list()
  st_multi@tr_counts    <- list()
  st_multi@spatial_meta <- list()
  st_multi@sample_meta  <- tibble(sample = character(0))
  for (nm in names(st_per_fov)) {
    s <- st_per_fov[[nm]]
    st_multi@counts[[nm]]       <- s@counts[[nm]]
    st_multi@tr_counts[[nm]]    <- s@tr_counts[[nm]]
    st_multi@spatial_meta[[nm]] <- s@spatial_meta[[nm]]
    st_multi@sample_meta <- rbind(st_multi@sample_meta, s@sample_meta)
  }

  cat("\nCosMx STlist built: ", length(names(st_multi@spatial_meta)),
      " FOV(s): ", paste(names(st_multi@spatial_meta), collapse = ", "),
      "\n", sep = "")
  saveRDS(st_multi, file.path(cosmx_cfg$step123,
                              "stlist_CosMx_multiFOV_SCT.rds"))

  STs$cosmx <- list(st      = st_multi,
                    smp1    = names(st_multi@spatial_meta)[1],
                    out_dir = cosmx_cfg$out_dir,
                    label   = paste0("CosMx (",
                                     length(names(st_multi@spatial_meta)),
                                     " FOVs)"),
                    fov     = requested)
  rm(seu, counts_all, coords_all, st_per_fov); invisible(gc())
  cat("CosMx STlist ready.\n")
} else {
  cat("CosMx: skipped.\n")
}
cat("\nBuilt platforms: ", paste(names(STs), collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r representatives}
plat_lab   <- c(visium = "Visium", cosmx = "CosMx")
has_visium <- !is.null(STs$visium)
has_cosmx  <- !is.null(STs$cosmx)

rep_visium <- function(smp, mode, manual) {
  manual <- as.character(unlist(manual))
  if (identical(mode, "manual") && length(intersect(manual, smp)) > 0)
    return(head(intersect(manual, smp), 2))
  ffpe   <- grep("^ffpe",   smp, value = TRUE)
  frozen <- grep("^frozen", smp, value = TRUE)
  if (length(ffpe) >= 1 && length(frozen) >= 1) return(c(ffpe[1], frozen[1]))
  head(smp, 2)
}

rep_cosmx <- function(st, io_map, mode, manual, min_cells = 10) {
  smp    <- names(st@spatial_meta)
  manual <- as.character(unlist(manual))
  if (identical(mode, "manual") && length(intersect(manual, smp)) > 0)
    return(head(intersect(manual, smp), 2))
  info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(smp, function(s) {
    ct <- as.character(st@spatial_meta[[s]]$cell_type)
    p  <- stringr::str_match(s, "^(RCC\\d+)_fov(\\d+)$")
    io <- io_map$IO[io_map$Slide_name == p[1, 2] & io_map$fov == as.integer(p[1, 3])]
    data.frame(fov   = s,
               IO    = if (length(io)) io[1] else NA_character_,
               n_cd8 = sum(grepl(params$cd8_label, ct, ignore.case = TRUE)),
               n_m2  = sum(grepl(params$m2_label,  ct, ignore.case = TRUE)),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  ok   <- info$n_cd8 >= min_cells & info$n_m2 >= min_cells
  best <- function(lbl) {
    x <- info[ok & info$IO %in% lbl, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(x)) x$fov[which.max(x$n_cd8 + x$n_m2)] else NA_character_
  }
  pick <- c(best("IO-naive"), best("IO-exposed"))
  pick <- pick[!is.na(pick)]
  if (length(pick) < 2) pick <- unique(c(pick, smp))[seq_len(min(2, length(smp)))]
  pick
}

FOVS_PLOT <- list()
if (has_visium)
  FOVS_PLOT$visium <- rep_visium(names(STs$visium$st@spatial_meta),
                                 params$representative_mode,
                                 params$representative_visium)
if (has_cosmx)
  FOVS_PLOT$cosmx <- rep_cosmx(STs$cosmx$st, io_map,
                               params$representative_mode,
                               params$representative_cosmx)

io_of <- function(f) {
  p <- stringr::str_match(f, "^(RCC\\d+)_fov(\\d+)$")
  io_map$IO[match(paste(p[, 2], p[, 3]),
                  paste(io_map$Slide_name, io_map$fov))]
}

overview <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(STs), function(nm) {
  n_units <- vapply(STs[[nm]]$st@spatial_meta, nrow, integer(1))
  data.frame(Platform = plat_lab[[nm]],
             Samples  = length(n_units),
             Unit     = if (nm == "visium") "spots" else "cells",
             Total    = format(sum(n_units), big.mark = ","),
             Median   = format(round(median(n_units)), big.mark = ","),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
names(overview)[4:5] <- c("Total units", "Median per sample")

reps <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(FOVS_PLOT), function(nm) {

             Sample   = s,

                        else io_of(s),

                               integer(1)),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

tex_esc <- function(x) gsub("_", "\\_", x, fixed = TRUE)
unit_of <- c(visium = "section", cosmx = "FOV")
ctx_of  <- function(nm, s) {
  if (nm == "visium") return(ifelse(grepl("^ffpe", s), "FFPE", "fresh frozen"))
  io <- io_of(s); ifelse(is.na(io), "IO status unknown", io)
}
samp_name <- function(nm, s) sprintf("%s (%s)", tex_esc(s), ctx_of(nm, s))
samp_lab  <- function(nm, s) paste(unit_of[[nm]], samp_name(nm, s))
cap_each  <- function(nm, fmt)
  unname(vapply(FOVS_PLOT[[nm]], function(s) sprintf(fmt, samp_lab(nm, s)), ""))
cap_pair  <- function(nm)
  paste(vapply(FOVS_PLOT[[nm]], function(s) samp_name(nm, s), ""), collapse = " and ")

natural_factor <- function(x) {
  x   <- as.character(x)
  u   <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", u)))
  factor(x, levels = u[order(num, u)])
}
natural_niche_order <- function(p) {
  strata_aes <- c("stratum", paste0("axis", 1:20))
  rewrap <- function(m) {
    for (a in intersect(names(m), strata_aes)) {
      q <- rlang::as_quosure(m[[a]], env = globalenv())
      env <- new.env(parent = rlang::quo_get_env(q))
      env$natural_factor <- natural_factor
      m[[a]] <- rlang::new_quosure(
        rlang::call2("natural_factor", rlang::quo_get_expr(q)), env)
    }
    m
  }
  is_niche <- function(x) (is.character(x) || is.factor(x)) && length(x) &&
    all(grepl("^C[0-9]+$", as.character(x[!is.na(x)])))
  fix_data <- function(d) {
    if (!is.data.frame(d)) return(d)
    for (v in names(d)) if (is_niche(d[[v]])) d[[v]] <- natural_factor(d[[v]])
    d
  }
  if (!is.null(p$mapping)) p$mapping <- rewrap(p$mapping)
  p$data <- fix_data(p$data)
  for (l in p$layers) {
    if (!is.null(l$mapping)) l$mapping <- rewrap(l$mapping)
    if (is.data.frame(l$data)) l$data <- fix_data(l$data)
  }
  p
}

show_plots <- function(p) {
  if (inherits(p, "ggplot")) print(p) else for (q in p) print(q)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Running STniche

STniche is run jointly on all samples of a platform, so niche labels (C1, C2, ...) are shared across
samples and directly comparable. The ten gene sets below were chosen to cover the programmes that
define lymphoid organisation (TLS, germinal centre, antigen presentation) and the inflammatory
signalling that accompanies it (interferon, complement, NF-kB, cytokine pathways).

```{r gene-set-table}
gs_desc <- c(
  TLS_core              = "TLS organisation and lymphocyte homing chemokines",
  GC_Bcell              = "Germinal-centre B-cell programme",
  Antigen_Presentation  = "MHC class II antigen presentation",
  IFNG_RESPONSE         = "Interferon-gamma response (T-cell activity)",
  COMPLEMENT            = "Complement cascade",
  IFNA_RESPONSE         = "Type I interferon response",
  TNFA_NFKB             = "TNF-alpha / NF-kB signalling",
  IL2_STAT5_TGFB        = "IL-2/STAT5 and TGF-beta signalling",
  IL6_JAK_STAT3         = "IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signalling",
  INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE = "General inflammatory response")
gs_tab <- data.frame(
  `Gene set` = names(params$stniche_gene_sets),
  Genes      = vapply(params$stniche_gene_sets, length, integer(1)),
  Readout    = unname(gs_desc[names(params$stniche_gene_sets)]),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
show_table(gs_tab, caption = "Gene sets used to define niches.", digits = 0)
```

Two neighbourhood sizes (`stniche_knns`) are run. The first (kNN = 22) is the primary analysis used in
all figures; the second serves as a sensitivity check. Each run starts from the same input object, so the
niche labels stored in the STlist always correspond to the Zi matrix used alongside them.

```{r stniche-run, echo=TRUE, results="hide"}
stniche_knns      <- as.integer(params$stniche_knns)
stniche_ks        <- as.integer(params$stniche_ks)
stniche_gene_sets <- lapply(params$stniche_gene_sets,
                            function(v) as.character(unlist(v)))

for (nm in names(STs)) {
  st0  <- STs[[nm]]$st
  runs <- lapply(stniche_knns, function(k)
    spatialGE::STniche(x = st0, gene_sets = stniche_gene_sets,
                       samples = names(st0@spatial_meta),
                       ks = stniche_ks, knns = k, out_i = TRUE,
                       cores = n_cores, verbose = 1L))
  names(runs)   <- paste0("knn", stniche_knns)
  STs[[nm]]$st   <- runs[[1]][[1]]
  STs[[nm]]$fits <- lapply(runs, `[[`, 2)
  STs[[nm]]$alt  <- lapply(runs, `[[`, 1)
}
Zi_of <- function(nm) STs[[nm]]$fits[[1]]
```

niche_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(STs), function(nm) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(FOVS_PLOT[[nm]], function(s) {
    tb <- table(STs[[nm]]$st@spatial_meta[[s]]$STniche_DTC)
    data.frame(Platform = plat_lab[[nm]], Sample = s,
               Niches = length(tb), Smallest = min(tb), Largest = max(tb),

  }))
}))

robust_tab <- NULL
if (length(stniche_knns) >= 2 && requireNamespace("mclust", quietly = TRUE)) {
  lab_vec <- function(st) unlist(lapply(names(st@spatial_meta), function(s) {
    d <- st@spatial_meta[[s]]
    setNames(as.character(d$STniche_DTC), paste0(s, "&&", d$libname))
  }))
  robust_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(STs), function(nm) {
    a <- lab_vec(STs[[nm]]$alt[[1]]); b <- lab_vec(STs[[nm]]$alt[[2]])
    common <- intersect(names(a), names(b))
    common <- common[!is.na(a[common]) & !is.na(b[common])]
    data.frame(Platform = plat_lab[[nm]],
               `kNN (primary)` = stniche_knns[1],
               `kNN (check)`   = stniche_knns[2],
               `Adjusted Rand index` =
                 mclust::adjustedRandIndex(a[common], b[common]),
               check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# Spatial organisation of niches

A useful niche should form spatially coherent territories. The maps below colour each spot or cell by niche, and the second set of maps shows the underlying
Local Moran's Z signal for the TLS gene set that the niches are partly built from.

## Niche maps

```{r niche-maps-visium, echo=TRUE, eval=has_visium, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.8, fig.cap=cap_each("visium", "STniche niches in %s.")}
p <- plot_stniche(STs$visium$st, type = "clusters",
                  samples = FOVS_PLOT$visium, overlay_samples = FALSE,
                  ptsize = 0.9, title = "STniche niches - Visium")
show_plots(p)
```

```{r niche-maps-cosmx, echo=TRUE, eval=has_cosmx, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.8, fig.cap=cap_each("cosmx", "STniche niches in %s.")}
p <- plot_stniche(STs$cosmx$st, type = "clusters",
                  samples = FOVS_PLOT$cosmx, overlay_samples = FALSE,
                  ptsize = 0.9, reverse_y = TRUE,
                  title = "STniche niches - CosMx")
show_plots(p)
```

## Local Moran's Z of the TLS gene set

High Zi marks locations where TLS-associated genes are *locally clustered*, which is the signal that
lets STniche separate lymphoid aggregates from diffusely expressing tissue.

```{r zi-maps, echo=TRUE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.8, fig.cap=unlist(lapply(names(STs), function(nm) cap_each(nm, "Local Moran's Z of the TLS\\_core gene set in %s.")))}
for (nm in names(STs)) {
  Zi <- Zi_of(nm)
  gs <- if ("TLS_core" %in% rownames(Zi)) "TLS_core" else rownames(Zi)[1]
  p  <- plot_stniche(STs[[nm]]$st, type = "Zi", zi = Zi, gene_set = gs,
                     samples = FOVS_PLOT[[nm]], overlay_samples = FALSE,
                     ptsize = 0.8, reverse_y = identical(nm, "cosmx"),
                     title = sprintf("%s - Local Moran's Z - %s", gs, plat_lab[[nm]]))
  show_plots(p)
}
```

# Biological identity of niches

Spatial coherence alone does not say what a niche *is*. We characterise each niche by (i) the mean
Zi of every gene set across all of its members, which gives its functional signature, and
(ii) for CosMx, its cell-type composition.

## Gene-set signatures

Each tile is the mean Local Moran's Z of a gene set within a niche (red = programme spatially
concentrated, blue = spatially depleted). Values are pooled over all samples of the platform, and the
number of spots or cells in each niche is shown beneath its label.

```{r niche-signature, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.2, fig.cap=unname(vapply(names(STs), function(nm) sprintf("Mean Local Moran's Z of each gene set within each %s niche. Values are pooled over all %d %ss; n is the number of %s in the niche.", plat_lab[[nm]], length(STs[[nm]]$st@spatial_meta), unit_of[[nm]], c(visium = "spots", cosmx = "cells")[[nm]]), ""))}
for (nm in names(STs)) {
  p <- plot_stniche(STs[[nm]]$st, type = "niche_signature", zi = Zi_of(nm),
                    palette = c(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B"),
                    title = sprintf("%s: gene-set signature of each niche", plat_lab[[nm]]))
  print(p)
}
```

## Cell-type composition of CosMx niches

Because CosMx resolves single cells, each niche can be annotated with the cell types that populate it.
This links the molecular signatures above to concrete cellular neighbourhoods (for example, immune
aggregates versus tumour or stromal regions).

### Cluster × cell-type heatmap

For each representative FOV, this heatmap shows the fraction of each niche's cells that belong to each
cell type. Rows are niches, columns are cell types, and cell values are the proportion of cells in that
niche assigned to that cell type. Bright tiles therefore mark the dominant cell types of a niche, so a
niche with a single bright column is a "pure" niche and one with many moderate tiles is a "mixed" niche.

```{r cluster-by-celltype, echo=TRUE, eval=has_cosmx, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, fig.cap=cap_each("cosmx", "Cell-type composition of STniche niches in %s.")}
for (nm in intersect(names(STs), "cosmx")) {
  for (s in FOVS_PLOT[[nm]]) {
    ht <- plot_stniche(STs[[nm]]$st, samples = s,
                       type = "celltype_heatmap",
                       title = sprintf("Cell types within STniche clusters | %s", s))
    if (inherits(ht, "Heatmap")) {
      draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
    } else if (is.list(ht)) {
      for (h in ht) if (inherits(h, "Heatmap")) draw(h, heatmap_legend_side = "right")
    }
  }
}
```

### Cell-type composition per niche (stacked bars)

The heatmap is compact, but it is hard to judge from it how much of a niche a cell type actually
occupies. A stacked bar answers that directly: each bar is one niche, its segments sum to 100%, and the
number of cells behind it is printed beneath the label. This serves three purposes. First, it shows how
*pure* a niche is (a single dominant cell type) versus how *mixed* it is. Second, it puts all niches on a
common scale so that they can be compared side by side. Third, drawing the representative samples in
separate panels shows whether a niche with the same label has the same cellular make-up in different
samples (here IO-naive versus IO-exposed), which pooled summaries would hide. The bars are compositional:
they describe shares of a niche, not enrichment relative to the whole tissue, so they should be read
together with the heatmap and with the niche size.

```{r celltype-per-cluster, echo=TRUE, eval=has_cosmx, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, fig.cap=sprintf("Cell-type composition of each STniche niche in the representative FOVs %s. Bar segments sum to 100%% of the cells in the niche; n is the number of cells. Rare cell types are collapsed into Other.", cap_pair("cosmx"))}
for (nm in intersect(names(STs), "cosmx")) {
  p_list <- plot_stniche(STs[[nm]]$st, type = "celltype_composition",
                         samples = FOVS_PLOT[[nm]],
                         title = "Cell-type composition per cluster")
  for (s in names(p_list)) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", s, " (", io_of(s), ")\n\n", sep = "")
    print(p_list[[s]])
  }
}
```

## Niche correspondence between samples

The alluvial plots connect niches of the two representative samples through the gene-set programme
they share most strongly. Link colour shows the shared programme, so flows of one colour indicate niches in different
samples (FFPE versus frozen; IO-naive versus IO-exposed) that share the same dominant signal.

```{r alluvial, echo=TRUE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, fig.cap=unname(vapply(names(STs), function(nm) sprintf("Niche correspondence between the two representative %ss, %s.", unit_of[[nm]], cap_pair(nm)), ""))}
for (nm in names(STs)) {
  p <- plot_stniche(x = STs[[nm]]$st, type = "multi_sample_alluvial",
                    samples = FOVS_PLOT[[nm]], zi = Zi_of(nm),
                    title = sprintf("%s niche correspondence", plat_lab[[nm]]))
  print(natural_niche_order(p))
}
```

# Validation against TLS pathology (Visium)

GSE175540 provides a pathologist label for every spot (`TLS`, `T_agg` for T-cell aggregates, or no
structure). These labels were **not** used by STniche, so they provide an independent test of whether
the niches capture real lymphoid organisation.

```{r tls-validation, eval=has_visium, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.2, fig.cap=c(sprintf("Pathologist annotation of TLS and T-cell aggregates (T\\_agg) in the Visium sections %s.", cap_pair("visium")), sprintf("STniche niches in the same sections (%s).", cap_pair("visium")))}
st_v <- STs$visium$st

annot <- lapply(FOVS_PLOT$visium, function(s) {
  fp <- list.files(file.path(visium_cfg$ds_root, s, "spatial"),
                   pattern = "TLS_annotation\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(fp) || !file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
  raw <- read.csv(fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  bc  <- intersect(c("Barcode", "barcode", "libname", "spot", "spot_id"),
                   colnames(raw))[1]
  lb  <- intersect(c("TLS_2_cat", "TLS", "TLS_CAT", "tls", "pathology"),
                   colnames(raw))[1]
  if (is.na(bc) || is.na(lb)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(libname = trimws(as.character(raw[[bc]])),
             TLS     = trimws(as.character(raw[[lb]])),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(TLS = ifelse(is.na(TLS) | TLS == "", "NO_TLS", TLS))
})
names(annot) <- FOVS_PLOT$visium

dropped <- names(annot)[vapply(annot, is.null, logical(1))]
if (length(dropped))
  message("No usable TLS_annotation.csv for: ", paste(dropped, collapse = ", "),
          " — these samples are omitted from the TLS validation.")
annot <- annot[!vapply(annot, is.null, logical(1))]
if (length(annot) == 0)
  stop("No representative Visium sample has a usable TLS annotation file ",
       "(looked under: ", file.path(visium_cfg$ds_root, FOVS_PLOT$visium, "spatial"),
       ").")

joined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(annot), function(s) {
  st_v@spatial_meta[[s]] %>%
    transmute(libname = trimws(as.character(libname)), xpos, ypos,
              Niche = as.character(STniche_DTC)) %>%
    left_join(annot[[s]], by = "libname") %>%
    mutate(TLS = ifelse(is.na(TLS) | TLS == "", "NO_TLS", TLS),
           sample = s)
}))
joined$sample <- factor(joined$sample, levels = names(annot))

pal_tls <- c(NO_TLS = "grey85", T_agg = "#1F77B4", TLS = "#00C853")
extra   <- setdiff(unique(joined$TLS), names(pal_tls))
if (length(extra))
  pal_tls <- c(pal_tls, setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(extra), "Dark 3"), extra))
lev     <- sort_clusters(joined$Niche)
pal_nic <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(lev), "Set 3"), lev)

spot_map <- function(col, pal, legend_title) {
  ggplot(joined, aes(xpos, ypos, colour = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, breaks = names(pal), name = legend_title,
                        na.value = "grey90") +
    coord_equal() + scale_y_reverse() +
    facet_grid(. ~ sample, scales = "free", space = "free") +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
print(spot_map("TLS",   pal_tls, "Pathology"))
print(spot_map("Niche", pal_nic, "Niche"))
```

The table lists, for every niche, how many spots carry each pathology label and the fraction annotated
as TLS or T-cell aggregate. A niche with a high fraction is a candidate lymphoid-structure niche.

```{r tls-crosstab, eval=has_visium}
all_lab  <- sort(unique(joined$TLS))
lab_cols <- setdiff(all_lab, "NO_TLS")

xt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(annot), function(s) {
  j   <- joined[joined$sample == s & !is.na(joined$Niche), ]
  tb  <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(
           factor(j$Niche, levels = sort_clusters(j$Niche)),
           factor(j$TLS,   levels = all_lab)))
  pct <- if (length(lab_cols))
           100 * rowSums(tb[, lab_cols, drop = FALSE]) / rowSums(tb) else 0
  data.frame(Sample = s, Niche = rownames(tb), tb,
             `% TLS or T_agg` = pct,
             check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
xt <- xt[order(xt$Sample, -xt$`% TLS or T_agg`), ]
show_table(xt, caption = "Pathology labels per STniche niche (spot counts), ordered by TLS enrichment.", digits = 1)
```

# Immune context and immunotherapy exposure (CosMx)

The CosMx tumours include patients with and without prior immunotherapy (IO). The final analyses ask
whether cytotoxic CD8 T cells and M2-like macrophages, two cell types with opposing roles in anti-tumour
immunity, differ by IO status, whether they are spatially associated, and whether the niches in which CD8 T
cells reside differ in their immune signalling.

## Abundance of CD8 T cells and M2 macrophages

Cell-type fractions are computed from the published annotation for every FOV with a known IO status.
This establishes the baseline immune composition before examining spatial relationships.

```{r abundance, eval=has_cosmx, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.8, fig.cap="CD8 T-cell and M2-macrophage fractions per FOV by IO status (Wilcoxon rank-sum test)."}
fov_tbl <- celltypes %>%
  mutate(Slide_name = sub("_(\\d+)$", "", unique_fov),
         fov        = as.integer(sub("^.*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", unique_fov))) %>%
  group_by(unique_fov, Slide_name, fov) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(),
            CD8 = 100 * mean(grepl(params$cd8_label, lasso_final, ignore.case = TRUE)),
            M2  = 100 * mean(grepl(params$m2_label,  lasso_final, ignore.case = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(io_map, by = c("Slide_name", "fov")) %>%
  filter(n_cells >= 10, IO %in% c("IO-naive", "IO-exposed")) %>%
  mutate(IO = factor(IO, levels = c("IO-naive", "IO-exposed")))

metric_lab <- c(CD8 = "CD8 T cells (% of cells)", M2 = "M2 macrophages (% of cells)")
fmt <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", median(x),
                           unname(quantile(x, .25)), unname(quantile(x, .75)))

ab_stats <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(metric_lab), function(m) {
  a <- fov_tbl[[m]][fov_tbl$IO == "IO-naive"]
  b <- fov_tbl[[m]][fov_tbl$IO == "IO-exposed"]
  data.frame(Metric = metric_lab[[m]],
             `IO-naive`   = fmt(a),
             `IO-exposed` = fmt(b),
             `n (naive / exposed)` = sprintf("%d / %d", length(a), length(b)),
             p = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value),
             check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

long <- fov_tbl %>%
  select(unique_fov, IO, CD8, M2) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(CD8, M2), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "pct") %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(metric_lab[Metric], levels = metric_lab))
ann <- data.frame(Metric = factor(ab_stats$Metric, levels = metric_lab),
                  label  = paste("Wilcoxon p =", signif(ab_stats$p, 2)))

ggplot(long, aes(IO, pct, fill = IO)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, colour = "grey20") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = ann, aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label),
            vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("IO-naive" = "grey75", "IO-exposed" = "#E8908A"),
                    guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank())
```

```{r abundance-table, eval=has_cosmx, results="asis"}
print(show_table(ab_stats, caption = "Median (IQR) cell-type fraction per FOV.", digits = 3))
sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(fov_tbl$CD8, fov_tbl$M2, method = "spearman"))
cat(sprintf("\nAcross FOVs, CD8 and M2 fractions are correlated (Spearman rho = %.2f, p = %.2g), suggesting that both populations might have a tracking tendency for the overall immune infiltration.\n",
            unname(sp$estimate), sp$p.value))
```

## Spatial relationship between CD8 T cells and M2 macrophages

Abundance does not reveal whether the two cell types share tissue space. The maps show their positions in
the representative FOVs, and the cross-type Ripley's K function quantifies co-localisation across all FOVs:
it compares the number of M2 cells found within radius *r* of a CD8 cell with the number expected under
spatial randomness (values above zero indicate co-localisation).

```{r cd8-m2-map, eval=has_cosmx, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.8, fig.cap=sprintf("Spatial distribution of CD8 T cells and M2 macrophages in the representative FOVs %s.", cap_pair("cosmx"))}
map_plot <- function(s) {
  plot_stniche(STs$cosmx$st, type = "celltype_spatial", samples = s,
               highlight_types = c(CD8 = params$cd8_label, M2 = params$m2_label),
               highlight_cols  = c(CD8 = "#E66101", M2 = "#7B3294"),
               ptsize = 1.1, reverse_y = TRUE, legend_name = "Cell class",
               title = sprintf("%s (%s)", s, io_of(s)))[[s]]
}
map_list <- lapply(FOVS_PLOT$cosmx, map_plot)
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  patchwork::wrap_plots(map_list, nrow = 1, guides = "collect")
} else {
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = map_list, nrow = 1)
}
```

```{r ripley, eval=has_cosmx, results="asis", fig.width=7, fig.height=4.2, fig.cap="CD8 to M2 cross-type K function (observed minus expected under randomness). Thin lines: individual FOVs; thick lines: group means. Group means (blue = IO-naive, red = IO-exposed) run above the dashed null line in both groups, indicating CD8-M2 co-localisation irrespective of IO status; the two group means overlap and the individual FOV curves span a wide range, consistent with the absence of an IO-group difference in excess K at r = 200 (Wilcoxon p = 0.68). The gradual rise with radius reflects the cumulative nature of K and points to diffuse, region-level co-localisation of the two populations (cf. Figure 19 and the positive CD8-M2 correlation reported under Table 7) rather than tight cell-contact-scale clustering."}
if (requireNamespace("spatstat.geom", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("spatstat.explore", quietly = TRUE)) {
  st_c  <- STs$cosmx$st
  radii <- seq(0, 200, by = 20)

  rows <- list()
  for (s in names(st_c@spatial_meta)) {
    d <- st_c@spatial_meta[[s]]
    d$cell_type <- as.character(d$cell_type)
    cd8 <- d[grepl(params$cd8_label, d$cell_type, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
    m2  <- d[grepl(params$m2_label,  d$cell_type, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
    if (nrow(cd8) < 10 || nrow(m2) < 10) next
    both <- rbind(data.frame(x = cd8$xpos, y = cd8$ypos, type = "CD8"),
                  data.frame(x = m2$xpos,  y = m2$ypos,  type = "M2"))
    pp   <- spatstat.geom::ppp(both$x, both$y,
                               window = spatstat.geom::owin(range(d$xpos), range(d$ypos)),
                               marks  = factor(both$type, levels = c("CD8", "M2")))
    k_cross <- tryCatch(
      spatstat.explore::Kcross(pp, i = "CD8", j = "M2", r = radii,
                               correction = "border"),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Kcross failed for ", s, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
    if (is.null(k_cross)) next
    rows[[s]] <- data.frame(sample = s, IO = io_of(s), r = radii,
                            delta = as.numeric(k_cross$border) - as.numeric(k_cross$theo),
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  k_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)

  if (!is.null(k_df) && nrow(k_df) > 0) {
    k_df$IO <- factor(k_df$IO, levels = c("IO-naive", "IO-exposed"))
    print(
      ggplot(k_df, aes(r, delta, colour = IO)) +
        geom_line(aes(group = sample), alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.5) +
        stat_summary(aes(group = IO), fun = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                     geom = "line", linewidth = 1.6) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c("IO-naive" = "#2C7FB8", "IO-exposed" = "#D7301F"),
                            name = NULL) +
        labs(x = "Radius (coordinate units)", y = "K observed - K expected",
             subtitle = sprintf("%d FOVs with at least 10 CD8 and 10 M2 cells",
                                length(unique(k_df$sample)))) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 11))

    at_max <- k_df[k_df$r == max(radii), ]
    if (all(table(at_max$IO)[c("IO-naive", "IO-exposed")] > 0)) {
      wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(delta ~ IO, data = at_max))
      cat(sprintf("\nAt r = %d, median excess K is %.0f (IO-naive, n = %d) versus %.0f (IO-exposed, n = %d); Wilcoxon p = %.2g.\n",
                  max(radii),
                  median(at_max$delta[at_max$IO == "IO-naive"]),
                  sum(at_max$IO == "IO-naive"),
                  median(at_max$delta[at_max$IO == "IO-exposed"]),
                  sum(at_max$IO == "IO-exposed"), wt$p.value))
    }
  }
}
```


## Immune signalling in CD8 T-cell niches

Finally, we ask whether the *microenvironment around CD8 T cells* differs by IO status. For each FOV we
average the Local Moran's Z of every gene set over its CD8 T cells (FOVs with at least five CD8 cells).
Testing each gene set between IO groups highlights programmes (for example interferon signalling) that differ between groups.

```{r cd8-pathways, eval=has_cosmx, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.6, fig.cap="Mean Local Moran's Z of each gene set in CD8 T cells, per FOV, grouped by IO status."}
st_c <- STs$cosmx$st
Zi   <- Zi_of("cosmx")

cd8_cols <- lapply(names(st_c@spatial_meta), function(s) {
  d   <- st_c@spatial_meta[[s]]
  ct  <- as.character(d$cell_type)
  key <- intersect(paste0(s, "&&", d$libname[grepl(params$cd8_label, ct, ignore.case = TRUE)]),
                   colnames(Zi))
  if (length(key) < 5) return(NULL)
  setNames(list(rowMeans(Zi[, key, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)), s)
})
cd8_cols <- unlist(cd8_cols, recursive = FALSE)

if (length(cd8_cols) >= 4) {
  m  <- do.call(cbind, cd8_cols)
  io <- io_of(colnames(m))
  keep <- !is.na(io) & io %in% c("IO-naive", "IO-exposed")
  m  <- m[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  io <- factor(io[keep], levels = c("IO-naive", "IO-exposed"))
  o  <- order(io, colnames(m))
  m  <- m[, o, drop = FALSE]; io <- io[o]

  lim <- max(abs(m), na.rm = TRUE)
  ha  <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    IO = io,
    col = list(IO = c("IO-naive" = "#2C7FB8", "IO-exposed" = "#D7301F")),
    annotation_name_side = "left")
  draw(Heatmap(m, name = "Mean Zi",
               col = colorRamp2(c(-lim, 0, lim), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
               top_annotation = ha, column_split = io, column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
               cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
               show_column_names = FALSE, row_names_side = "left",
               row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)),
       heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")

  if (all(table(io) >= 2)) {
    path_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rownames(m), function(g) {
      a <- m[g, io == "IO-naive"]; b <- m[g, io == "IO-exposed"]
      data.frame(`Gene set` = g,
                 `Mean Zi, naive`   = mean(a, na.rm = TRUE),
                 `Mean Zi, exposed` = mean(b, na.rm = TRUE),
                 p = tryCatch(suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value),
                              error = function(e) NA_real_),
                 check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
    path_tab$FDR <- p.adjust(path_tab$p, method = "BH")
    path_tab <- path_tab[order(path_tab$p), ]
  }
}
```

```{r cd8-pathway-table, eval=has_cosmx}
if (exists("path_tab"))
  show_table(path_tab,
             caption = sprintf("IO-naive versus IO-exposed CD8 T-cell niches (%d naive and %d exposed FOVs; Wilcoxon test, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR).",
                               sum(io == "IO-naive"), sum(io == "IO-exposed")),
             digits = 3)
```
